name: Jacksonville International Airport
before:
Thirteen miles north of downtown Jacksonville, and a straightforward airport to use. Ticketing is on the second floor at the front of the terminal with baggage claim below it, and both lead back to a mezzanine holding the shops, the restaurants and a single security checkpoint. Past that are Concourses A and C with ten gates each, so twenty in total.

Passenger numbers set a record in the 2024 financial year at just over 7.6 million, up almost five per cent on the year before. It remains a joint civil and military field, which shows in the traffic mix: military movements sit alongside scheduled flights, air taxi work and general aviation.

For anyone without a car, the Route 1 bus runs into downtown and connects to the Greyhound network and the Skyway monorail. Worth knowing if there is time before a flight: three galleries sit off the main courtyard before security, one of them a permanent exhibit on aviation in the region.
after:
About 12 miles north of downtown Jacksonville, and a straightforward airport to use. Check-in is on the upper level with baggage claim below it, and both lead back to a central courtyard with the shops, the restaurants and a single security checkpoint. Past that are Concourses A and C with ten gates each, so twenty in total.

Passenger numbers were about 7.6 million in the year to September 2025, just short of the record set the year before. It remains a joint civil and military airport, with an Air National Guard fighter wing based on the field.

For anyone without a car, JTA's Route 1 bus runs between the airport and downtown. Worth knowing if there is time before a flight: art galleries sit around the central courtyard before security.

claims.note: Was 'thirteen miles' (Wikipedia). The written figures differ: the operator's Concourse B environmental assessment says about 12 miles, Wikipedia 13 miles and the FAA record 9 nautical miles (about 10.4 statute miles). The straight line from the GeoNames centre is 11.2 miles at 350 degrees, north; 12 passes the coordinates check (ratio 1.07), so the text follows the operator. flyjacksonville.com is OurAirports' home link; Wikipedia's flyjax.com is the operator's other address (op-home names it).
